name: Nijou Hatsune
source:
[b]Gyaru Lover Crossdressing Protagonist[/b]

Since childhood, he has been fascinated by gyaru—not just in a physical sense, but ideologically as well. As a result, he developed a strong fondness for gyaru girls. However, because there were no gyaru-type girls around him, he found himself starved of what he loved.

After much deliberation, he ended up taking up the unusual hobby of dressing as a gyaru himself to fill that void. He doesn’t see this hobby as something to be ashamed of. That said, he’s also aware that he's fundamentally a guy and knows he can't keep crossdressing as a gyaru forever.

With that in mind, he takes selfies dressed in his ideal gyaru form and post them in a secret gyaru-themed crossdressing account on social media. However, he avoids showing his face, only posting photos from the neck down to prevent being recognized.

Although he dresses as a gyaru, he's still a guy on the inside—his behavior and sexual orientation are completely normal.


•His birthday it's the same day as the "Gyaru's day"
•He is good at: Housework.
•He is bad at: Making plans.
